title: MUSCLE MANGA - Yujiro Hanma's Physique in Grappler Baki (part. 2)
summary: A scripted manga analysis of Yujiro Hanma after the Vietnam war: his leaner, more streamlined physique, and the wedding where he humiliates and kills the groom to take Baki's mother Emi as his mate.
claims: After Vietnam, Yujiro returned with black slicked hair and a calmer aura; his ogre traits (leathery skin, mass) seem tied to his time on the battlefield
Yujiro and later Baki (180 to 160 lb) both slimmed down, as if extra fluff hurt performance, to rebuild on a more solid base with leaner physiques
In Baki, downsizing brings no loss of strength; the leaner Yujiro is as dangerous as his bulkier teenage self
Burying opponents into the ground expresses dominance on both a symbolic and physical level
Choking someone by lifting them by the scruff of the neck is the most alpha move possible and needs huge strength
Yujiro chose Emi for her sadism, ideal for bearing warriors, and did not care about her physical genes, trusting Hanma DNA
